plan.summary: This 4-week block is the first part of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan with two S&C sessions per week around a higher sparring load. Week 1 establishes training maxes on the two primary lifts so percentage work can start cleanly in Week 2. The block then builds lower-body and upper-body strength, keeps fast explosive work in every session, and trims accessory volume so you can recover well for boxing. Main program loading starts in Week 2, with Week 4 acting as a lighter deload to keep quality high before the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish baseline strength, build general force and power, and keep speed work crisp without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and power work while keeping lifting volume conservative around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more of the work toward fast, sharp output while holding onto the strength built earlier.
